data.message: I commit to 18 tons; this is an individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching10→18 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but cuts remaining stock by8 and low-outcome stock by16. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. This isn't guaranteed best long-term. Join even if others choose10?
